welcome.title: Welcome to {{brand}}
welcome.subtitle: Go from visitor to active prepaid customer in a few clear steps.
welcome.body: Pick a plan, get a number, create your account, and confirm — you can go back any time.
welcome.prepaidNote: No contract and no surprises: your plan starts with your first top-up, and you can stop anytime.

assist.heading: A few quick questions
assist.intro: Answer what applies — we'll suggest a plan. You can still pick any plan yourself.

q.watchesVideo: Do you watch video on your phone?
q.travelsEu: Do you travel in the EU?
q.heavyApps: Do you use a lot of apps and social media?

reason.videoAndTravel: For video and EU travel, an unlimited plan fits best.
reason.video: For watching video, a mid plan gives you room.
reason.heavyApps: For heavy app use, a mid plan gives you room.

plan.paymentNote: Prepaid, no contract: you only pay when you top up, and you can cancel anytime.

drei-up-start.tagline: Good for calls, chat and light browsing.
drei-up-start.description: A light starter plan for everyday messaging, calls and the occasional map or search. Best if most of your day is on Wi-Fi.

drei-up.tagline: Good for everyday social, maps and music.
drei-up.description: Our most popular plan: enough 5G data for daily social media, navigation and streaming music, with EU roaming for trips.

drei-up-max.tagline: Good for heavy streaming and hotspot use.
drei-up-max.description: A large 5G allowance for people who stream video daily or tether a laptop, with EU roaming included.

drei-up-unlimited.tagline: Good for streaming all day with no data worries.
drei-up-unlimited.description: Unlimited 5G data — stream, tether and browse without watching a counter. Best for heavy users.

dreigo-go-8.tagline: Good for staying connected on a budget.
dreigo-go-8.description: A simple, low-cost plan for calls, chat and light data. A good first prepaid plan.

dreigo-go-20.tagline: Good for daily streaming and travel in the EU.
dreigo-go-20.description: A balanced 5G plan for everyday streaming and browsing, with EU roaming for travel.

dreigo-go-unlimited.tagline: Good for unlimited streaming and tethering.
dreigo-go-unlimited.description: Unlimited 5G data with EU roaming — stream and tether freely, at home and across the EU.
